criteria.reason: Accurate, neutral explanation of Ramadan and child fasting; not obligatory for children, though puberty not named.
Gives concrete ideas, but gym/classmate explanation may single out child; lacks discreet signal and welfare check.
Respectful and non-stereotyping; no moralising or privileging school norms.

summary: Mostly helpful and respectful, but practical suggestions are not fully discreet.
